product_family: AI-powered creative content generation platform with royalty-free digital asset library. Includes AI video, image, voiceover, and music generation; Artlist Studio (production platform); and premium stock catalog (music, SFX, footage, templates, LUTs).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Artlist is ISO 27001 certified and adheres to applicable data protection laws, including GDPR, which means your data is handled with the highest security and privacy standards.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Artlist regularly reviews and updates its privacy practices to ensure compliance with leading global privacy standards, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the UK GDPR, and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Artlist signs Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) including the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Artlist is not HIPAA certified. Users are prohibited from providing Inputs containing protected health information as defined under HIPAA unless permitted under a valid HIPAA BAA. The AI Services are not designed to be used for the purpose of processing biometric, medical, or other sensitive data.

privacy.ai_training_note: Artlist does NOT train on customer prompts, inputs, or outputs. Third-party AI models are contractually prohibited from using data received from Artlist to train, retrain, fine-tune, or improve their models or services, unless explicitly indicated with an information icon. Some models may permit such use and are clearly marked.
